decisions.reason: It closely builds on the firm's decades of space optical and navigation heritage, so the firm can readily assimilate and improve it, making drop unlikely.

As a modular line of navigation cameras, it leverages existing optoelectronic know-how and aligns with the firm's shift toward flexible, reprogrammable sensors, supporting continued learning and low drop probability.

The sensor suite extends the firm's established optical and electronic sensor capabilities into space situational awareness, allowing it to evaluate and refine the product using existing knowledge and research networks.

Although LiDAR is an advanced technology, the firm's optical and optoelectronic expertise and collaboration with research institutions give it the absorptive capacity to develop and improve the miniaturized sensor, so it is likely kept.
